methodology: Spatial Engineering: 720 individual bore permit coordinates were first validated and mapped to Victorian suburb centroids using a KDTree (Nearest Neighbor) join to ensure 100% projection alignment. Density Modeling: Aggregated permit counts onto a granular 0.1-degree geographic grid to create a 'Thermal Field' effect. Color Logic: A custom Magma ramp (Purple to Yellow) was applied to highlight Critical Stress Zones (10+ permits per hub).
citation: Bureau of Meteorology. (2026). Australian Groundwater Explorer: Bore Water Levels. ArcGIS Hub.
